claims.notes: Desk computation; upper-bound style estimate assuming constant re-boosting. Fewer pies are needed where only some obstacles need the boost (e.g. Ardougne). The first decay can come early (background cycle).

sources.title: Agility potion
sources.quote: This requires level 34 [[Herblore]], and grants 80 Herblore experience. Agility potions temporarily raise your [[Agility]] by 3.

sources.title: Lobster

claims.subject: Swordfish

sources.title: Swordfish
sources.quote: '''Swordfish''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 14 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten.

claims.subject: Jug of wine

sources.title: Jug of wine
sources.quote: '''A jug of wine''' is a type of [[Drinks|drink]] that restores 11 [[Hitpoints]] and temporarily lowers [[Attack]] by 2, leaving behind an empty [[jug]] after consumption.

sources.title: Wilderness Agility Course
sources.quote: For this reason, a source of cheap food (such as [[wines]]) can be useful to help restore lost [[health]].

claims.subject: Ardougne Market
claims.value: bakery stalls sell bread, cakes and chocolate cake slices
claims.statement: The two bakery stalls in Ardougne Market (where the Ardougne course starts) sell bread, cakes and chocolate cake slices, so food can be bought on site for coins.

sources.title: Ardougne Market
sources.quote: They both sell the same items but are owned by different owners. They sell [[bread]], [[cake]]s, 1/3 [[chocolate cake]]s, and [[chocolate bar]]s.

claims.notes: Do not steal from the stalls: guards and knights attack thieves (same page).

claims.subject: Rooftop Agility Courses
claims.value: regen bracelet and/or Hitpoints cape near the course minimum
claims.statement: Near a rooftop course's minimum level, a regen bracelet or Hitpoints cape can beat food for healing fail damage because they weigh less and need no inventory.

sources.title: Rooftop Agility Courses
sources.quote: A tip while doing rooftop Agility is to wear a [[regen bracelet]] and/or hitpoints cape if you are at, or near, the minimum level required to access the rooftop course, as they increase the rate at which [[Hitpoints]] regenerate after failing obstacles.

claims.notes: The Hitpoints cape needs 99 Hitpoints (owner 48). The regen bracelet's main-game proxy price is very high (see price claims).

claims.subject: Seers' Village Rooftop Course
claims.statement: Seers' has two failable obstacles (Jump Gap 1 and Tightrope), which stop failing at 79 Agility; bring food until then.

sources.title: Seers' Village Rooftop Course
sources.quote: There are two locations where the player may fail; Jump Gap 1 and Tightrope Walk. These obstacles will stop failing at 79 Agility.

claims.notes: Fail damage for Seers' is not stated on the course or obstacle pages read (gap).

claims.subject: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course
claims.statement: The Pollnivneach course cannot be failed from 85 Agility.

sources.title: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course
sources.quote: At level 85 Agility, it becomes impossible to fail any part of the course.

claims.subject: Rellekka Rooftop Course
claims.statement: On the Rellekka course players stop failing the first tightrope at 85 Agility.

sources.title: Rellekka Rooftop Course
sources.quote: At level 85 Agility, players stop failing at the first tightrope.

claims.notes: The quote covers the first tightrope only; other failable points were not checked.

claims.subject: Ardougne Rooftop Course
claims.statement: Players stop failing the Ardougne course at 95 Agility.

sources.title: Ardougne Rooftop Course
sources.quote: Players stop failing this course at 95 [[Agility]].

claims.subject: Falador Rooftop Course
claims.value: 3–8 (Hand Holds); no fails from 66
claims.statement: On the Falador course the Hand Holds can be failed for 3–8 damage until 66 Agility.

sources.title: Falador Rooftop Course
sources.quote: It's possible to fail during the "Hand Holds" section, dealing 3–8 damage.

sources.title: Falador Rooftop Course
sources.quote: At 66 [[Agility]] you will stop failing the course.

claims.subject: Canifis Rooftop Course
claims.statement: Canifis has one failable gap, which stops failing at 64 Agility.

sources.title: Canifis Rooftop Course
sources.quote: The chance to succeed starts at 88.28% at level 40 Agility, scaling linearly until the player stops failing the obstacle at level 64 Agility.

claims.subject: Wilderness Agility Course
claims.value: floor(current HP x 0.15)+1 (falls) or floor(current HP x 0.2)+1 (stepping stones)
claims.statement: Wilderness course fails deal floor(current HP x 0.15)+1 (falls into the dungeon) or floor(current HP x 0.2)+1 (third stepping stone), and level 18/25 skeletons attack nearby players.

sources.title: Wilderness Agility Course
sources.quote: |Can be failed, which will send the player down to the [[Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon|dungeon]] below and deal <math>\left\lfloor\text{Current hitpoints}\times0.15\right\rfloor+1</math> damage.

sources.title: Wilderness Agility Course
sources.quote: In addition to the risk of [[player-killers]], there are multiple level 18 and 25 [[skeleton]]s roaming the course and underground respectively that will attack any player near them.

claims.notes: Flag for Threat Analyst: deep Wilderness, PvP.

claims.subject: Seers' Village Rooftop Course
claims.value: start is beside Seers' Village bank
claims.statement: The Seers' course starts by climbing the wall near the entrance of Seers' Village bank, so the bank is at the start.

sources.title: Seers' Village Rooftop Course
sources.quote: The Seers' Village Rooftop Agility Course can be started by climbing up the wall near the entrance of [[Seers' Village bank]] and is finished by jumping off the roof of the [[Seers' Village church|church]], by the [[Yew tree|Yew trees]].

claims.subject: Camelot Teleport
claims.value: Magic 45 (owner 44); lands at Camelot gate; Seers' bank option needs Kandarin Hard diary
claims.statement: The Camelot Teleport spell needs 45 Magic (owner has 44) and lands at Camelot's front gate; moving it to Seers' bank needs the hard Kandarin diary (owner has none).

sources.title: Camelot Teleport

sources.title: Camelot Teleport
sources.quote: After completing the [[Hard Kandarin Diary|Kandarin Hard tasks]], you may switch the location of the teleport to [[Seers' Village bank]] by right-clicking the spell and choosing Toggle-location.

claims.subject: Camelot teleport (tablet)

claims.statement: Camelot teleport tablets are GE-tradeable and can be used without the Magic level, so the owner can reach Seers' with tablets now.

sources.title: Camelot teleport (tablet)

claims.subject: Pollnivneach
claims.value: only house teleport or a redirected house tablet teleports directly
claims.statement: The only direct teleports to Pollnivneach are a house teleport (house there) or the Pollnivneach redirected tablet; otherwise the magic carpet is used.

sources.title: Pollnivneach teleport
sources.quote: This tablet is the only method (outside of a normal [[House Teleport]] with a [[POH|house]] in Pollnivneach) of teleporting directly to Pollnivneach.

claims.subject: Pollnivneach teleport
claims.value: untradeable; made from a teleport-to-house tablet plus a scroll of redirection at 20 Construction
claims.statement: The Pollnivneach teleport tablet is untradeable and made by using a scroll of redirection on a teleport-to-house tablet at 20 Construction (owner has 23).

sources.title: Pollnivneach teleport
sources.quote: |tradeable = No

sources.title: Pollnivneach teleport
sources.quote: It can be created at level 20 [[Construction]] by using a [[scroll of redirection]] on a [[teleport to house]] tablet.

claims.subject: Scroll of Redirection

claims.statement: Scrolls of redirection come only from the Nightmare Zone reward shop (775 points each) and are untradeable; NMZ is an unsafe death on Hardcore Worlds, so redirected Pollnivneach/Rellekka tablets are not a safe option.

sources.title: Scroll of Redirection
sources.quote: '''Scrolls of redirection''' are a reward from the [[Nightmare Zone]], costing 775 reward points per scroll.

claims.subject: Magic carpet

claims.statement: Magic carpets from Shantay Pass to Pollnivneach cost 200 coins per trip (100 with Ring of Charos (a) or after starting Rogue Trader).

sources.title: Magic carpet
sources.quote: The carpets require 200 [[coins]] to use, but this falls to 100 coins when using the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] or after having started the [[Rogue Trader]] miniquest.

sources.title: Pollnivneach
sources.quote: *[[Shantay Pass]] to Pollnivneach or back

claims.subject: Shantay Pass
claims.value: bank chest at Shantay Pass (members); pass costs 5 coins
claims.statement: Shantay Pass has a members' bank chest, so with the carpet it is the practical bank for the Pollnivneach course; entering the desert needs a 5-coin Shantay pass.

sources.title: Shantay Pass
sources.quote: The Shantay Pass has a [[bank chest]] which players can access before entering the desert. The bank is only available to members, but the [[Bank Deposit Box|deposit box]] is available in [[free-to-play]].

sources.title: Shantay Pass
sources.quote: Players will need to have 5 coins to buy a [[shantay pass (item)|pass]] from [[Shantay]], or have completed the elite [[Desert Diary]], if they wish to enter the desert.

claims.notes: Pollnivneach's town page lists no bank, only a Banknote Exchange Merchant; 'nearest bank' is the desk's reading.

claims.subject: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course
claims.statement: Pollnivneach is not affected by desert heat, so no waterskins are needed for the course.

sources.title: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course
sources.quote: Pollnivneach is not affected by [[desert heat]], so no waterskins are required.

claims.subject: Pollnivneach
claims.value: crocodiles (63, aggressive) south of town; jackals aggressive to combat 42 or lower
claims.statement: In Pollnivneach the bandits and Menaphite thugs are not aggressive, but aggressive level 63 crocodiles live south of town, and jackals south-west are aggressive to combat level 42 or lower.

sources.title: Pollnivneach
sources.quote: *[[Crocodile]]s - Crocodiles populate the area south of town and may be dangerous to lower levelled players as their combat level is 63. They are aggressive.

sources.title: Pollnivneach
sources.quote: These are aggressive to players with a combat level of 42 or less and can wander into areas affected by [[Desert heat]].

claims.notes: Flag for Threat Analyst; the course itself is in town.

claims.statement: The enchanted lyre (closest teleport) needs The Fremennik Trials (not completed); Camelot Teleport works but leaves a very long run north.

sources.title: Rellekka teleport
sources.quote: It is extremely close to the [[enchanted lyre]] teleport location (requires completion of The Fremennik Trials).

sources.title: Rellekka
sources.quote: * {{Plink|Camelot Teleport}} — Camelot, a very long run south of the village.

claims.notes: Fremennik sea boots need the Fremennik diary and fairy rings need Fairytale II; neither is in the brief.

claims.subject: Rellekka

claims.statement: Rellekka lacks a nearby bank; Peer the Seer acts as a deposit box only after the Easy Fremennik diary.

sources.title: Rellekka
sources.quote: * {{Chatl|Peer the Seer}}, a seer who can see the future and can also help you make [[Skeletal armour]]. After completion of the [[Fremennik Diary#Easy|Easy Fremennik Diary]] he acts as a bank deposit box.

claims.notes: The page says the Rellekka mining area has no nearby bank (line 124); no bank is listed for the town. The nearest full bank was not established (gap).

claims.subject: Ardougne teleport (tablet)

claims.statement: Ardougne teleport tablets are GE-tradeable and need Plague City (which the owner has); the spell itself needs 51 Magic (owner has 44), so tablets are the owner's route.

sources.title: Ardougne teleport (tablet)
sources.quote: Using the tablet requires completion of [[Plague City]], however, players '''do not''' have to read the [[Ardougne teleport scroll]] to use the tablet.

sources.title: Ardougne Teleport
sources.quote: |level = 51

claims.subject: Ardougne Rooftop Course
claims.value: Ardougne Teleport lands in the market centre; course starts in the market's south-east corner
claims.statement: Ardougne Teleport lands in the centre of Ardougne Market, and the course starts at the wooden beams by the gem stall in the market's south-east corner.

sources.title: East Ardougne
sources.quote: The [[Ardougne Teleport]] spell teleports the caster into the centre of the Ardougne Marketplace.

sources.title: Ardougne Rooftop Course
sources.quote: It can be started by climbing the Wooden Beams outside of the house next to the [[Ardougne Gem Stall.|gem stall]] in the south-east corner of the marketplace.

claims.subject: East Ardougne
claims.value: banks near the north entrance and near the docks (south bank)
claims.statement: East Ardougne has banks near the north entrance and near the docks (the southern bank).

sources.title: East Ardougne
sources.quote: Near the main north entrance of Ardougne and near the docks of Ardougne is a [[bank]].

claims.notes: Exact distance from the course start was not measured.

claims.subject: East Ardougne
claims.statement: A lever near the West Ardougne gate teleports the player to the Deserted Keep in deep Wilderness; avoid it.

sources.title: East Ardougne
sources.quote: *A [[Ardougne teleport lever|Teleport Lever]] - near the gates to [[West Ardougne]], there is a small house. It teleports the player to the [[Deserted Keep]] in deep [[Wilderness]] (or vice versa).

claims.notes: Flag for Threat Analyst.

claims.subject: Canifis Rooftop Course
claims.value: starts just north of Canifis bank
claims.statement: The Canifis course (needs Priest in Peril, completed) starts at the Tall Tree just north of the bank and ends on the bank's north side.

sources.title: Canifis Rooftop Course
sources.quote: The Canifis Rooftop Agility Course can be started by climbing the Tall Tree just north of the [[bank]] and is finished by jumping off the north side of the bank.

claims.subject: Ectophial
claims.value: free reusable teleport to the Ectofuntus (far east of Canifis); reward of Ghosts Ahoy
claims.statement: The ectophial (Ghosts Ahoy reward, completed) is a free, reusable, untradeable teleport to the Ectofuntus outside Port Phasmatys, which is far east of Canifis.

sources.title: Ectophial
sources.quote: The '''ectophial''' is a reward for completing the [[Ghosts Ahoy]] quest. Players can empty it, causing them to be teleported to the [[Ectofuntus]] outside [[Port Phasmatys]].

sources.title: Canifis
sources.quote: * {{Plink|Ectophial}} — [[Ectofuntus]], far east of the town.

claims.subject: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
claims.statement: The Colossal Wyrm course needs Children of the Sun (completed) and 50 Agility (basic) or 62 (advanced).

sources.title: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
sources.quote: There are two courses available to players beginning at 50 Agility for the basic course, and 62 Agility for the advanced course.

claims.subject: Colossal wyrm teleport scroll
claims.value: GE-tradeable or 40 termites; usable after visiting Varlamore post-Children of the Sun
claims.statement: Colossal wyrm teleport scrolls (fastest way to the course) are GE-tradeable or cost 40 termites from Worm Tongue, and work once the player has visited Varlamore after Children of the Sun.

sources.title: Colossal wyrm teleport scroll
sources.quote: They can be purchased from [[Worm Tongue's Wares]] for 40 [[termites]] obtained from the [[Colossal Wyrm Agility Course]].

sources.title: Colossal wyrm teleport scroll
sources.quote: The scroll is only usable once the player has visited [[Varlamore]] for the first time after completing the [[Children of the Sun]] quest.

sources.title: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
sources.quote: * Use a [[Colossal wyrm teleport scroll]], bought from [[Worm Tongue]] or the [[Grand Exchange]]. This is the quickest method to get there.

claims.subject: Landing Site
claims.value: Twilight's Promise
claims.statement: Quetzal landing sites, including the one near the Colossal Wyrm Remains, are only usable after Twilight's Promise (not completed) and must be built from 10 quetzal feed, 3 limestone bricks and 4 soft clay.

sources.title: Landing Site
sources.quote: Initially unusable, players are gifted their own quetzal, [[Renu]], to access these landing sites during [[Twilight's Promise]].

sources.title: Landing Site
sources.quote: Building each landing site requires 10 [[quetzal feed]], 3 [[limestone brick]]s and 4 pieces of [[soft clay]] and can be done without any tools.

claims.subject: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
claims.value: basic ~25% and advanced ~40% longer; XP/termites raised to keep similar hourly rates
claims.statement: On 12 August 2026 the Colossal Wyrm course got longer (basic ~25%, advanced ~40%), with XP, bone shards and termites raised so hourly XP and termites stay about the same; parts of the wiki course page are marked obsolete.

sources.title: Update:Summer Sweep Up - Agility & Chambers of Xeric Changes
sources.quote: * Increased XP, Bone shards and Termites to match so that it's roughly the same XP/hr and termites/hr but fewer inputs/hr, meaning the course is lower intensity than before.

sources.title: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
sources.quote: {{Obsolete|Changes to course durations, experience, termites, and bone shards.|update=Update:Summer Sweep Up - Agility & Chambers of Xeric Changes}}

claims.notes: Within the recency window. Termite-per-lap figures on the course page may be outdated.

claims.subject: Wilderness Agility Course
claims.value: Ice plateau tablet (lands in level 53 Wilderness) or Wilderness obelisk/Edgeville lever
claims.statement: The fastest way to the Wilderness course is an Ice plateau teleport tablet (no requirements to use, GE-tradeable) to level 53 Wilderness, then run east; banking is via the obelisk to Ferox Enclave.

sources.title: Ice plateau teleport (tablet)
sources.quote: The '''Ice plateau teleport''' is a [[magic tablet]] that can be broken by players to [[Teleportation|teleport]] to the members half of the [[Ice Plateau]] in level 53 [[Wilderness]].

sources.title: Wilderness Agility Course
sources.quote: Bank time is assumed to be 2 minutes, 10 seconds, and done by leaving the course, running through the gate to the Wilderness obelisk, traveling to the 13-Wilderness option (Ferox Enclave), using the bank, and then returning with an [[Ice plateau teleport (tablet)|Ice Plateau tablet]].

claims.notes: WILDERNESS / PvP: flag for Threat Analyst. Tablets are made at 89 Magic on Lunar (thin HW supply likely).

claims.subject: Wilderness Agility Course
claims.statement: The Wilderness course's optional loot fee is 150,000 coins, paid from the inventory and lost on every death or exit; without it the course is free but gives no loot.

sources.title: Wilderness Agility Course
sources.quote: The fee is 150,000 coins, which is lost '''every time''' a player dies or leaves the course, but is not removed if they log out and remain within the course.

claims.subject: Brimhaven Agility Arena
claims.statement: Brimhaven Agility Arena charges 200 coins per entry, and logging out inside means paying again.

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: *Bring 200 [[coins]] to pay [[Cap'n Izzy No-Beard]] for access to the arena. It is recommended to bring more, as this fee has to be paid upon each entry.

claims.subject: Brimhaven Agility Arena
claims.value: boat from East Ardougne or Rimmington; charter ship; glory to Musa Point
claims.statement: To reach Brimhaven Agility Arena, take the boat from East Ardougne or Rimmington, a charter ship, or an amulet of glory to Musa Point and run west.

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: *Take the boat from [[East Ardougne]] or [[Rimmington]] to Brimhaven or alternatively take a [[charter ship]].

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: *Teleport to [[Musa Point]] using an [[amulet of glory]] and run west.

claims.notes: The listed Fight Cave minigame-teleport route passes the TzHaar area; the TzHaar Fight Cave is UNSAFE on HW (just passing through is not the minigame, but flag it).

claims.subject: Brimhaven Agility Arena
claims.value: small-heal food or summer pies; energy-restoring items needed
claims.statement: At Brimhaven bring food (summer pies, or small heals like chocolate cake or strawberries, because trap damage scales with current HP) and enough energy-restoring items to run constantly.

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: **Food that heals in small increments such as [[chocolate cake]]s or [[strawberries|baskets of strawberries]] are another good choice, as the damage the traps deal to your health scale with how much health you currently have.

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: *Bring enough [[Energy#Energy-restoring action|energy-restoring items]] for enough [[energy]] to constantly run around the course.

claims.notes: Quantity per hour not given (gap). Darts traps drain Agility by 2 on failure (summer pies offset this).

claims.subject: Brimhaven Agility Arena
claims.value: Karamja gloves 2/3/4: +10% obstacle and ticket XP
claims.statement: Karamja gloves 2, 3 or 4 give 10% extra Brimhaven obstacle and ticket XP (they need the Karamja diary, which the owner does not have).

sources.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
sources.quote: *Wear [[Karamja gloves 2]], [[Karamja gloves 3|3]], or [[Karamja gloves 4|4]] for 10% extra Agility experience from obstacles in the Brimhaven Agility Arena.

claims.subject: Agility Pyramid
claims.value: waterskins (desert heat) and food; fails deal up to 10 damage
claims.statement: The Agility Pyramid is in desert heat, so bring waterskins and food (unless Desert Elite diary); falls deal up to 10 damage.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: Otherwise, players will need to bring enough [[waterskin]]s and [[food]] for the training.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: Upon failure, the Agility Pyramid is capable of hitting a player for 10 damage, so [[Ironman Mode#Hardcore|hardcore ironmen]] should be wary.

claims.subject: Agility Pyramid
claims.value: magic carpet Shantay Pass→Pollnivneach→Nardah, then walk
claims.statement: One route without diaries: carpet from Shantay Pass to Pollnivneach, then a carpet to Nardah and walk south-west to the pyramid.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: * Alternatively, take a magic carpet from [[Shantay Pass]] to Pollnivneach and follow the instructions above.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: ** Take a magic carpet to [[Nardah]] and walk south-west from Nardah.

claims.subject: Agility Pyramid

claims.statement: Each pyramid top sells to Simon Templeton for 10,000 coins (up to about 26 tops/hour); sell each one at once because it weighs 11 kg.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: Pyramid tops may be handed in to [[Simon Templeton]] in exchange for {{NoCoins|10,000}} [[coins]] each and respawn only when the player has entered the doorway at the top of the pyramid.

sources.title: Agility Pyramid
sources.quote: Players are advised to sell each pyramid top to Simon Templeton immediately after obtaining it, since it weighs 11 kg and would otherwise increase run energy expenditure on future laps.

claims.subject: Werewolf Agility Course

claims.statement: The Werewolf Agility Course needs Creature of Fenkenstrain (not completed) and a Ring of Charos, so the owner cannot use it.
